messages:
Sam: CI Android instrumented tests started flaking when hitting MockWebServer over HTTPS. Seeing SSL handshake EOF and sometimes duplicate POSTs on the server. Anyone run into this combo (MockWebServer + cert pinning + OkHttp retries)?

Nora: Which OkHttp version? Also how are you handling request bodies in interceptors?

Sam: okhttp 4.11.0. We have an interceptor that computes a checksum by reading the body for logging and then does chain.proceed with the original Request. Example: 
```
Buffer buf = new Buffer();
request.body().writeTo(buf);
log.debug(buf.readUtf8());
return chain.proceed(request);
```

Alex: That's the red flag. If the interceptor consumes the body, retries will fail because the body isn't repeatable. OkHttp may retry on connection failure and try to re-send the request — but the body stream is empty. That can manifest as partial writes, closed sockets, or TLS EOF during handshake if connection reuse goes wrong.

Sam: Interesting. Why TLS EOF instead of a clear "body exhausted" error?

Nora: If a stale socket gets reused and the server closed it, the client opens a new connection and a partial/malformed first bytes can make the server tear down the TLS handshake, producing EOF or "Unexpected TLS packet". It's an interplay of retries, stale sockets, and non-repeatable bodies.

Alex: Quick fixes: 1) Don't read body in interceptor; if you must, buffer to byte[] and create a new RequestBody when calling chain.proceed. 2) For tests, make bodies repeatable (small JSON -> buffer). 3) Add an assertion in your androidTest that MockWebServer.getRequestCount() == 1 to catch duplicates.

Sam: Pragmatic approach: I'll change the interceptor to copy body bytes when size < 64KB and replace the request with a replayable RequestBody. Also will configure MockWebServer SSLContext to force TLSv1.2 and set protocols to HTTP_1_1 only for CI runs.

Nora: Also consider setting OkHttpClient.retryOnConnectionFailure(false) in tests only — but that's hiding a real behavior. Better to make request bodies repeatable or limit logging.

ci-bot: build #4128 (instrumentation) failed: flaky-network. Re-running... :gear:

Sam: I'll open a PR with a tiny RepeatableRequestBody util and a failing androidTest repro that toggles pinning. Alex/Nora can review. Thanks for the tips. :thumbsup:
